adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Steve Rogers, back in 2012 from the future, steps into an elevator with Rollins and his STRIKE agents and whispers "Hail Hydra" to trick them into handing over Loki's scepter.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A Captain America from the future, who tricks Rollins out of the scepter.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent Steve tricks out of the scepter in 2012 with a whispered "Hail Hydra."
adds.evidence: 2012 time heist: Rollins and STRIKE take the Scepter at Stark Tower; Steve intercepts them in the elevator and, feigning Hydra affiliation, gets them to hand it over.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: After the Snap, Rhodey and Steve are among the surviving Avengers at the compound. Rhodey joins the plan to bring back the Infinity Stones through time and fights beside Steve against the 2014 Thanos.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow surviving Avenger, beside whom Rhodes joins the time heist.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow surviving Avenger who joins the time heist beside Steve.
adds.evidence: Rhodes and Rogers reunite with Stark as the remaining Avengers, plan the Time Heist together (Rhodes goes to 2014 Morag with Nebula), and both fight in the Battle of Earth.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Thor leaves Earth with Groot and the Guardians. When Thor and Quill argue over who leads, Groot is all for settling it with knives, and Thor rules out any knifing.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: God who joins Groot and the Guardians as they leave Earth.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian Thor leaves Earth with, keen to settle the leadership spat with knives.
adds.evidence: Closing Benatar scene: Thor joins the Guardians; quote 'I am Groot.' / 'Not necessary!' / 'There shall be no knifing one another.' (Groot, Star-Lord, Thor).

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Groot and Peter Quill, back from the Snap, set off together with the Guardians. When Quill and Thor argue over who leads, Groot is ready for a knife fight, and Quill says it's not necessary.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow Guardian who sets off with Groot, and turns down a knife fight.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow Guardian, all for settling Quill's leadership spat with Thor by knives.
adds.evidence: Closing Benatar scene: Groot agrees to Quill and Thor fighting with knives; Quill answers 'Not necessary!'.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Nebula rejoins the Guardians aboard the Benatar with Groot. When Quill and Thor argue over who leads, she suggests they fight for it and Groot wants knives.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow Guardian who sets off into space with Groot after the battle.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian she sets off into space with after the battle.
adds.evidence: Nebula rejoins the Guardians in the Benatar with Rocket, Drax, Mantis, Groot and Quill; she suggests Thor and Quill fight for leadership, and Groot chimes in for knives.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Happy Hogan watches Tony's last message with Pepper Potts and her daughter at the lake house, then stays with Morgan after the funeral and promises her cheeseburgers.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's widow, whose daughter Happy looks after at the funeral.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Old friend who watches Tony's last message with Pepper and looks after Morgan.
adds.evidence: Tony Stark's funeral: Hogan, along with Pepper Potts, Morgan and others, watches Tony's recording at the Stark Eco-Compound; afterwards he sits with Morgan and promises her cheeseburgers.
